svg.title: Nested hCaptcha: choose the task, map the input
svg.desc: A nested browser cutaway shows task classification, content-origin coordinates and the boundary between challenge continuation and an application receipt.
svg.text: A / Read the visible challenge first
Start with element bounds in its own frame
For each parent: position + border + padding
Then add the scaled child coordinate
Two nested borders (7 + 5 px) must not disappear.
Only the site’s application receipt confirms submission.
